title: First Passage Times for Variable-Order Time-Fractional Diffusion
summary: We derive the asymptotic first passage time (FPT) distribution for space-dependent variable-order time-fractional diffusion, where the fractional exponent $α(x)$ varies with position. On a bounded interval with an absorbing and a reflecting boundary, we show that the survival probability decays as $Ψ(t)\sim C\,t^{-α_*}/[\ln (t/τ)]^ν$, where $α_*$ is the minimum value of the fractional exponent and $ν$ is determined by the location and shape of the minimum.
